settings.heading: Partner with a brand built for label readers.
settings.body: We are looking for educators, creators, coaches, and community builders who care about ingredient transparency and responsible recommendations.

settings.label: Be specific
settings.heading: Explain the product honestly
settings.text: Share what the product is, who it may fit, and where people can read the complete label.

settings.label: Disclose
settings.heading: Make relationships visible
settings.text: Clearly disclose gifted product, commissions, and other material connections.

settings.label: Stay grounded
settings.heading: Avoid medical promises
settings.text: Do not turn a supplement recommendation into a disease claim or guaranteed outcome.
